question_stem: A parallel beam of $\gamma$-ray photons passes through lead of thickness $x$. The initial intensity is $I_0$ and the transmitted intensity is $I$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a $\gamma$-ray photon.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use Fig. 13.1 to determine the linear absorption coefficient $\mu$ of lead for these $\gamma$-ray photons.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: The lead is replaced by aluminium. Suggest and explain the effect of this replacement on the graph in Fig. 13.1.
